title: The Royal Garden Wedding
shortDescription: A luxurious and enchanting garden ceremony with classic white and gold decor.
fullDescription: Experience a fairy-tale wedding set amidst lush greenery and vintage fountains. This package includes full-service planning, gourmet catering, live string quartet, and a custom floral arch. Perfect for a grand celebration of 300+ guests.

title: Rustic Barn Ceremony
shortDescription: Charming, cozy, and natural celebration in a beautifully restored wooden barn.
fullDescription: A truly intimate affair featuring rustic wooden details, twinkling fairy lights, farm-to-table cuisine, and a cozy bonfire reception. Ideal for couples seeking a relaxed and authentic atmosphere for up to 150 guests.

title: Elegant Rooftop Reception
shortDescription: A sophisticated evening event with stunning city skyline views and modern minimalist design.
fullDescription: Celebrate under the stars with breathtaking panoramic city views. This package includes a contemporary setup, a signature cocktail bar, DJ services, and premium seating. Best suited for smaller, stylish evening parties of 80-120 guests.

title: Beachfront Destination Vows
shortDescription: Say 'I Do' on soft sands with the ocean breeze and a sunset backdrop.
fullDescription: An exotic and tranquil destination wedding package. Includes permit handling, a beautifully draped canopy, seashell-inspired décor, and a seafood grill reception. Perfect for adventurous couples and intimate gatherings.

title: Intimate Micro Wedding
shortDescription: A beautiful, budget-friendly ceremony focusing on close family and friends.
fullDescription: Proving that less is more, this micro wedding package focuses entirely on quality over quantity. Includes a dedicated photographer, bespoke floral arrangements, and a five-course dinner for a maximum of 50 guests.

title: Cultural Fusion Celebration
shortDescription: A vibrantly planned event blending two distinct cultures and traditions.
fullDescription: We expertly manage the complexities of a multi-day, multi-cultural celebration. Includes specialized vendor sourcing, custom decor for both ceremonies, and coordination of complex ritual timings. A beautiful way to honor both families.

title: Vintage Ballroom Gala
shortDescription: Timeless elegance with crystal chandeliers, marble floors, and classic decor.
fullDescription: A classic Hollywood romance brought to life in a grand, historic ballroom. Features a live big band, black-tie dress code, dramatic lighting, and champagne toast service. A truly formal and elegant affair for all ages.

title: Simple Civil Ceremony & Brunch
shortDescription: A simple and sweet courthouse ceremony followed by an intimate celebratory brunch.
fullDescription: The perfect solution for couples who value simplicity and efficiency. This includes legal paperwork assistance, professional photos near the courthouse, and a reserved private room for an upscale brunch.

title: Mountain Retreat Elopement
shortDescription: An adventurous, private ceremony with dramatic natural views.
fullDescription: For the couple seeking adventure. We organize logistics for remote, stunning mountain locations. Package includes specialized officiant, adventure photographer, and a celebratory picnic basket. Extremely intimate (under 10 guests).

title: Winter Wonderland Wedding
shortDescription: A magical, festive wedding complete with snowy landscapes and cozy indoor charm.
fullDescription: Transform your venue into a warm, sparkling haven. Features include faux snow décor, hot cocoa stations, velvet seating, and a fireplace setting. A beautiful way to celebrate during the colder months.
